Do not use it to split a transaction among categories: change_transaction does. The user confirms before categories change.

name: change_transaction

Use it when the user asks to fix, edit or relink a transaction. Returns an article of the equori guide: what a concept means in this app, how a task is done, and the screens where it is done with their paths. Use it for how-to and where-is questions, for concepts such as postings, statements or reconciliation, for the fields and the values a tool takes, before a write whose facts are not all known, and for tasks the assistant cannot do, such as adding bank credentials. Do not use it for the book's own data: the other tools return it. Topics:

transfers: money between own accounts

reconciliation: checking a balance against the institution
schedules_and_occurrences: recurring bills, income and subscriptions
budgets: monthly budgets and the budget plan
income_split: income divided into buckets
goals: savings goals and shared accounts
investments: brokerages, trades, prices and the portfolio
investment_operations: notes, corporate actions, custody and day trades
fixed_income: contracts, rates, terms and applications
fixed_income_payments: coupons, amortization, maturity and redemption
investment_income: dividends and other income of holdings
investments_br: Brazil: index of the product articles, tax year, issuer
fixed_income_br: Brazil: CDB, LCI, LCA, debentures, CRI, CRA: tax, IOF, FGC

funds_br: Brazil: open funds and come-cotas
contribution_plan: target split and where a contribution goes

privacy_and_the_assistant: privacy mode and what the assistant does not do

name: reconcile_account
description: Proposes a reconciliation step on an account: record the balance the institution reports at a date, resolve the open difference of a recorded balance, or unlock reconciled postings from a date. name: record_brokerage_note
description: Proposes one brokerage note: the several orders of one day at one Brokerage, with the costs and the withheld tax of the whole note. Each order becomes a trade of its own, in the order given; the costs are split by gross value. Use it when the user reports a note or more than one trade of the same day at the same Brokerage. Each security must exist: manage_instrument defines a new one. Do not use it for one trade whose own costs are known: record_investment does. The user confirms first.

name: record_corporate_action
description: Proposes a corporate action on one Investment: a split, a reverse split, a bonus of units or the units a fund cancels for income tax (unit_tax). The quantity changes and the cost of the holding stays; a bonus with unit_cost adds that cost and records an exempt income. A conversion moves the whole cost to new_instrument; a spin_off moves cost_percent of it. A right is sold with record_investment sell. A fraction of a unit leaves the position; its auction cash is recorded with record_investment kind income when it arrives. Use it when the user reports one of these events on a holding. An action is not corrected: void_transaction removes it and it is recorded again. Do not use it for a dividend or other cash income: record_investment does. The user confirms first.

kind.description: split: more units for each one held; reverse_split: fewer units; bonus: units received for free; unit_tax: units of a fund cancelled for income tax; conversion: the holding becomes new_instrument (merger, ticker change); spin_off: units of new_instrument beside the holding; right_issue: subscription rights new_instrument beside the holding, at no cost; right_exercise: the rights become new_instrument (share or receipt) for amount; capital_return: amount paid back lowers the cost

account_id.description: Investment line, from list_accounts; instead of brokerage_id and instrument

brokerage_id.description: Brokerage that holds the Investment; with instrument, instead of account_id

instrument.description: code of the Investment, such as PETR4

date.description: first day without the right; for unit_tax, the day the units were cancelled

ratio_from.description: split, reverse_split and bonus: units held, the For each of the notice, from 1 to 1000000

ratio_to.description: split, reverse_split and bonus: units received for each ratio_from held; a split of 1 into 10 is ratio_from 1 and ratio_to 10, a reverse split of 10 into 1 is 10 and 1, a bonus of 1 for each 10 is 10 and 1

unit_cost.description: bonus: cost per unit received that the company states, added to the cost of the holding and recorded as exempt income

category_id.description: bonus with unit_cost: income category, from list_accounts

quantity.description: unit_tax: positive quantity of units cancelled, below the units held

amount.description: unit_tax: income tax withheld; right_exercise: subscription price paid in total; in the base currency

cash_account_id.description: right_exercise: account that pays amount, from list_accounts; the cash account of the brokerage when empty

description.description: description of the transaction; a title derived from the kind and the investment when empty

new_instrument.description: conversion and spin_off: code of the security received

cost_percent.description: spin_off: percent of the cost moved to new_instrument, as the company's notice states

name: record_fixed_income

Use it when the user states an application with its issuer, amount, date, maturity and rate. Do not use it for a public security with a ticker: record_investment does. The user confirms first.

name: record_investment
description: Proposes an investment transaction in a Brokerage: buy or sell an Investment for the Cash of the same Brokerage, or record income paid on an Investment. A first buy creates the Investment line; a sale or income needs an existing one. A Brokerage with no Cash account in the base currency is refused: create one first with manage_accounts_and_payees. Use it when the user reports a trade, a dividend or other investment income. write_off removes units at zero proceeds, their cost a realized loss: an option expired, a right not exercised, a security that became worthless. With transaction_id and reason it corrects that trade or income instead of recording one: change_transaction does not correct them. Do not use it to define a new security: manage_instrument does. The user confirms first.

instrument.description: code of the Investment, such as PETR4

Do not use it for one price: manage_instrument record_price does. The user confirms first.

name: record_transaction
description: Proposes a new transaction: money moves from one account or category to another. A purchase moves from a checking, cash or card account to an expense category; income moves from an income category to an asset account; a transfer moves between two own accounts. With installments on a card it records an installment purchase; with original_amount on a card it records a foreign purchase; with to_amount between two currencies it records an exchange. Use it when the user asks to record, add or log a transaction. Do not use it to change an existing transaction: change_transaction does. The user confirms the proposal before anything is recorded.

The archive carries no credential of a bank integration: the owner adds them with a passphrase in Settings, Data. Do not use it to restore an archive: the owner does that in Settings, Data. Use it to find transactions by text, account, category, tag, period or missing category, and to get the transaction_id other tools take. Do not use it for totals by category: get_category_totals adds them up. Filters combine; narrow them instead of reading many pages.

It is allowed only while the book has no transaction: after the first one it is refused (settings_locked) and nothing changes it. Use it when the owner sets up a book in another currency; list_accounts shows the current one. Do not use it for the currency of one account: manage_accounts_and_payees does. The user confirms first.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the book adds its totals in, such as BRL or USD

name: set_card_face

It replaces the whole face: a value left out returns to the default, and a call with only account_id clears the face. Use it when the user asks to change the look of a card. Do not use it for the limit, the cycle or the plastic cards: manage_card does. The user confirms first.

Use it when the user pays a card bill or reports what the bank's statement says. Do not use it for one purchase: handle_card_purchase does. The user confirms first.

The receiving Brokerage gets the Investment line when it has none. Use it when the user moved a holding between brokers without selling it. A sale of the holding recorded after the date refuses the transfer (later_sale_exists). Do not use it for money: record_transaction with a transfer does. The user confirms first.

name: update_profile

language.description: ISO 639 language code, such as en or pt

name: void_transaction
description: Proposes voiding a transaction: it stops counting in balances and reports and stays in history with the reason. Use it when the user asks to delete, remove, cancel or void a transaction. Do not use it to change values: change_transaction does. The user confirms before the transaction is voided.
